resources.string: Learn, restore or disable previous, next and Siri keys. Choose Learn key, then press a key within 10 seconds. Only keys received by the app can be learned. Phone, volume, system and typing keys cannot be assigned. Disabling stops app forwarding; the car retains its own actions. Bluetooth media keys remain with the car. No CarPlay reconnect is needed.
